newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - September 23.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Gang leader nabbed at airport enroute to U.S.
Thousands of protesters march to protest Japanese presence on disputed islands.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Black-listed gang leader arrested.
Protesters sail for disputed islands north of Taiwan.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan government to assert fishing rights near disputed islands.
China Petroleum agrees to pay T$230 million for oil spill damages.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Unemployment rose 10-year high to over three percent in August.
Mutual assistance funds for medium and small enterprises to inaugurate on Thursday.
